name: archlens
description: ArchLens AI — turns PR diffs into visual architecture diagrams posted as GitHub PR comments.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const p=require('path'),f=require('fs');function up(d){let c=p.resolve(d);for(;;){const t=p.join(c,'scripts','run-patch-package.cjs');if(f.existsSync(t))return t;const parent=p.dirname(c);if(parent===c)return null;c=parent;}}const anchors=[process.env.npm_package_json?p.dirname(process.env.npm_package_json):null,process.cwd(),__dirname].filter(Boolean);let s=null;for(const a of anchors){s=up(a);if(s)break;}if(!s){console.error('[postinstall-bootstrap] could not locate scripts/run-patch-package.cjs; anchors tried: '+JSON.stringify(anchors));process.exit(1);}require(s);"
